children: Intuitive Surgical reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $3.05B, up 22% year‑over‑year, while net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. fell to $522.8M and diluted EPS was $1.49 for the quarter.
Revenue was $3.05B, compared with $2.51B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 22%.
Net income was $522.8M, compared with $704.4M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (25.8%).
Diluted EPS was $1.49, compared with $1.95 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (23.6%).
Total revenue growth was driven by an 18% increase in instruments and accessories and a 30% rise in systems sales.
Leasing accounted for 53% of Q3 system placements, with usage-based lease revenue increasing.
The da Vinci installed base reached 12,094 systems, up 12% year‑over‑year, including 2,023 da Vinci 5 systems; approximately 906K procedures were performed in the quarter (up 14%).
Ion platform momentum continued: installed base 1,152 (+21%) and procedures up 31%.
Operationally, the company placed 546 da Vinci systems in the quarter (315 da Vinci 5) and recognized IEEPA tariff refunds that aided gross margin.
